name: WarrantyClaimPortal
tagline: Dealer warranty claims with live coverage checks, 3C coding, labour, parts returns and attachments.
description: A Power Platform code component for OEM dealer portals: look up a unit by serial number, check base, extended or goodwill coverage by months, hours and component group, code the failure (complaint, cause, correction, failure and causal codes), add labour operations against standard times, parts with return tags and required attachments, and submit a validated claim with totals, markup and deductible. Includes the dealer's claim list with KPIs and returned-claim resubmission.
features: Serial typeahead and unit registration check
Coverage meter: months and hours vs policy, component-group extended warranty, deductible
Failure / causal codes and 3C texts with repeat-repair warning
Labour operations with standard-time variance justification
Parts with handling markup and return tags
Required attachment slots with type and size checks
Review with totals, coverage split and go-to-fix links
Dealer claim list with KPIs, returned/rejected reasons and resubmission
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and ARIA
